name: pablo-one-poc-api
description: Chat API Lambda (/api/chat, /api/greeting, /api/search) behind API Gateway and CloudFront.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --legal-comments=none
scripts.dev: esbuild src/dev.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=.dev/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node .dev/server.mjs
